basic_details.job_title: Spices Board Trainee Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 5 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Spices Board is recruiting candidates for 5 vacancies under Trainee (QEL Chemistry), Trainee (QEL Microbiology), and Trainee (Marketing) posts on a contract basis for a period of one year. The monthly stipend for each post is Rs. 20,000. Eligible candidates must submit their online application on or before 29 October 2026. The selection process consists of a Written Test followed by Certificate Verification, with the test and verification scheduled for 2 November 2026. Applicants must meet the post-wise qualification requirements specified in the official notification.

qualification.details: Candidates must possess the following post-wise essential qualifications: | Trainee (QEL Chemistry): Bachelor of Science Degree with Chemistry as one of the major subjects or Bachelor's degree in Chemistry from a recognized university or equivalent. Trainee (QEL Microbiology): Bachelor's Degree in Microbiology from a recognized University/Institute or equivalent. Trainee (Marketing): Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognized University/Institute with computer knowledge.

salary_details.details: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated stipend of Rs. 20,000/- per month. The tenure of training is one year from the date of joining, which is extendable up to one more year. Trainees are eligible for one day of leave per month.

selection_process: The selection method consists of a Written Test. Candidates are required to report at the venue for certificate verification prior to the test. Candidates reporting after the specified time or who fail to submit their application online will not be permitted to participate in the test.
how_to_apply: Visit the official recruitment portal at http://spicesboard.in/recruitment/
Submit the application online on or before 29.10.2026.
Report at the venue at least 30 minutes prior to the scheduled time for certificate verification on 02.11.2026.
Bring all original documents and certificates pertaining to identity, age, and educational qualifications, along with one set of self-attested copies each.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess the following post-wise essential qualifications: Trainee (QEL Chemistry): Bachelor of Science Degree with Chemistry as one of the major subjects or Bachelor's degree in Chemistry from a recognized university or equivalent. Trainee (QEL Microbiology): Bachelor's Degree in Microbiology from a recognized University/Institute or equivalent. Trainee (Marketing): Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognized University/Institute with computer knowledge. Candidates must not be more than 30 years of age as on the date of the written test. Candidates who have undergone training in any office of the Spices Board are not eligible to apply, regardless of whether they have completed the training or not. faq.question: Q1. Is this a permanent job or on contract, and for how long?
faq.answer: This is a training position on a contract basis for a period of one year from the date of joining, which is extendable up to one more year. The notification explicitly states that selection as a trainee is under no circumstances linked to regular appointments and cannot be regularized at any stage.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: The recruitment is exclusively for Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) candidates who meet the specific educational qualifications for Chemistry, Microbiology, or Marketing traineeships and are not older than 30 years as on the date of the written test.

faq.question: Q3. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who have undergone training in any office of the Spices Board are not eligible to apply, regardless of whether they have completed the training or not.

faq.question: Q4. Which documents are required to be brought for the test?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring all original documents and certificates pertaining to identity, age, and educational qualifications, along with one set of self-attested copies each for certificate verification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the online application?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the online application is 29.10.2026.
